clue.text: One needs wise men's race for creativity

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
the Magi are the three wise men of the Nativity story
a race of people is a nation

explanation.surface: A recipe for creativity calls for a people as wise as the Magi.
explanation.definitionFit: Creativity is the inventive faculty of the mind, the power to picture new things.

clue.text: Come across to the hunt party

definitions.meaning: to encounter someone
the gathering of riders and hounds before a fox hunt

explanation.definitionFit: To encounter is to come across someone, and a fox hunt's assembly of riders is called by the same word.

clue.text: Depart and be silent! Oh, my goodness!

parts.note: to depart is to go
sh is the command to be quiet

explanation.surface: Someone is told to leave and keep quiet, and gasps in surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: An exclamation of mild surprise, a softened oath in place of 'God'.

clue.text: Renowned despite incompetence

definitions.meaning: famous, well known
being incompetent is being '...', read as two words

explanation.surface: Someone became famous in spite of being hopeless at the job.
explanation.walkthrough: 'despite' is a link: the second definition takes the answer split into two words, NOT ABLE, which describes incompetence.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone renowned is remarkable and famous; split in two, the word says unable, which is what incompetence means.

clue.text: Husband only for a time

definitions.meaning: to husband land is to cultivate it, as in husbandry
up until a certain time, as in 'wait until then'

explanation.surface: A man is married only temporarily.
explanation.definitionFit: Farmers cultivate and plough the soil, which is husbandry; the same word is the conjunction meaning until.

clue.text: Not in file of the general plan

parts.note: someone not in is out
a file of people is a line, as in single file

explanation.surface: An absent item is missing from the file holding the general's plan.
explanation.definitionFit: A rough sketch giving the main features without the detail is a broad plan.

clue.text: They keep track of railway table waiters maybe

definitions.meaning: workers who lay and maintain railway track
people who set plates out on tables, read as two words

explanation.definitionFit: Railway workers who lay and maintain the rails; split as PLATE LAYERS, they could be waiting staff setting out dishes.

clue.text: Dessert wine more often drunk as an aperitif

definitions.text: Dessert wine more often drunk as an aperitif

parts.words: Dessert wine more often drunk as an aperitif
parts.note: a fortified wine whose sugary style suits pudding, yet which is commonly served before a meal

explanation.definitionFit: A sugary fortified Spanish wine fits the dessert course, yet the British often take a glass before dinner.

clue.text: Archaically spelt, this is one corner of the sail

definitions.meaning: an old spelling of the word for a crossword hint
the lower corner of a sail where the sheet attaches

explanation.definitionFit: An old spelling of the word for a puzzle hint, and the lower corner of a sail in nautical terms.

clue.text: List variety in order to demonstrate it!

definitions.text: List variety in order to demonstrate it!

indicators.note: putting the letters of the two words in a new order rearranges them

explanation.surface: Setting out a list of varieties shows how adaptable one is.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in order' signals that the letters of LIST VARIETY are rearranged; the whole clue describes what the answer does, since the letters show their flexibility.
explanation.definitionFit: Being able to turn to many uses is adaptability, which a rearrangeable string of letters displays.

clue.text: Little container is an eyesore

definitions.meaning: a small pen for pigs, here in its variant spelling
an inflamed swelling on the eyelid

explanation.definitionFit: A pigsty is a small enclosure, spelt this way as a variant; it is also a painful swelling on the eyelid.

clue.text: Chess opening possible reversal of SA resettlement policy

definitions.meaning: the phrase that tells a chess player which side plays first

definitions.text: possible reversal of SA resettlement policy
definitions.meaning: apartheid South Africa forcibly moved black people; reversing it would mean relocating the white population

explanation.definitionFit: Chess problems state which side plays first; apartheid South Africa relocated black citizens, so reversing it would relocate the whites.

clue.text: Going off the air just as clown is about to sing first note

indicators.note: the word clown goes round the other letters, being about them

parts.note: taken as written
do (doh) is the first note of the sol-fa scale

explanation.surface: Just as a broadcast ends, a clown is about to start singing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'is about' puts SING and DO inside CLOWN, splitting it as CLO and WN; 'just as' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A broadcaster that stops transmitting for the night is ending its service on the air.

clue.text: Bag, and don't grant bail to any of the suspects

definitions.meaning: a large travel bag

definitions.text: don't grant bail to any of the suspects
definitions.meaning: keep every suspect in custody

explanation.definitionFit: A large holdall bag carries everything; as an instruction it means keep every suspect in custody.

clue.text: French collaborator whichever way you look at him

indicators.text: whichever way you look at him
indicators.note: the name reads the same forwards as backwards, so either direction gives it

parts.note: these definition words give the whole answer, and the answer is itself the palindrome: it reads the same from either end

explanation.surface: A French traitor looks the same however you view him.
explanation.walkthrough: Pierre Laval was the Vichy French prime minister who collaborated with Nazi Germany and was executed in 1945.
explanation.definitionFit: Pierre Laval led Vichy France's government in partnership with the Nazi occupiers.

clue.text: Devotional reminder that the heavenly spirit leads us

indicators.note: coming in front of the other word, so placed first

parts.note: an angel is a heavenly spirit
taken as written

explanation.surface: A prayer reminds believers that an angel guides them.
explanation.walkthrough: The Angelus is a Catholic prayer, and the bell rung to call the faithful to it.
explanation.definitionFit: A Catholic prayer recited at morning, noon and evening, announced by a bell.

clue.text: Nothing in beers could be quite so bitter

indicators.note: the zero goes within the word for beers

parts.note: ales are beers
nothing is zero, the letter O

explanation.surface: A drinker finds nothing in beer could taste quite so bitter.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition is used as a noun, a bitter drug.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloes is a purgative drug from the aloe plant, famed for its harsh taste.

clue.text: Big bird is one up on a birdie of course

definitions.meaning: a large bird of prey

definitions.text: one up on a birdie of course
definitions.meaning: on a golf course, a score of two under par, one better than a birdie

explanation.definitionFit: A large bird of prey, and in golf a hole played two under par, one better than a birdie.

clue.text: Soviet commentators get news from it as sent

definitions.text: Soviet commentators get news from it as sent

indicators.note: the letters are taken out from within the words that follow

explanation.surface: Russian reporters relay their news exactly as transmitted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'from' takes letters out of 'it as sent'; TASS was the official news agency of the Soviet Union.
explanation.definitionFit: The state news agency of the Soviet Union was where its journalists sourced their reports.

clue.text: Cow-shed purchaser so we hear

indicators.note: the clue tells us we are hearing a word spoken

parts.note: a purchaser is a buyer

explanation.surface: A farmer hears there is someone wanting to buy the cowshed.
explanation.definitionFit: A traditional farm building where cattle are housed.

clue.text: People King Alfred wanted to send a-packing

definitions.text: People King Alfred wanted to send a-packing

parts.words: People King Alfred wanted to send a-packing
parts.note: the Viking invaders the Anglo-Saxon king of Wessex fought off in the ninth century

explanation.definitionFit: Alfred the Great of Wessex resisted the Viking raiders from Scandinavia who settled in England.

clue.text: Excavate it Albert, and find unsuitable watch for you?

parts.note: to excavate is to dig
taken as written
Al is short for Albert

explanation.surface: Albert is told to dig and find a watch that is wrong for you.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer is an adjective describing a kind of watch, one showing the time in figures rather than with hands.
explanation.definitionFit: A watch with a numerical display rather than hands is the electronic kind.

clue.text: Twelve bore old Japanese ruler swallowing his literal beverage

indicators.note: the ruler's title takes in the drink, swallowing it

parts.note: a shogun was a hereditary military ruler of old Japan
tea, the drink the ruler would have, is the letter T said aloud

explanation.surface: An old Japanese ruler drinks while holding a twelve-bore.
explanation.walkthrough: 'literal beverage' is tea as a letter: T.
explanation.definitionFit: A twelve-bore is the common gauge of a hunting firearm firing pellets.

clue.text: Wrapper for a toy sword maybe

definitions.meaning: kitchen wrapping sheet made of metal
a sword made of thin metal, a tin toy foil

explanation.definitionFit: Thin metal sheet used to wrap food; split, it is a fencing sword made of cheap metal, a plaything.

clue.text: One who fleeces a woman with rare device

parts.note: a woman is she

indicators.note: a device is a contrivance, so the letters are contrived into a new order

explanation.surface: A con artist turns out to be a woman with an unusual gadget.
explanation.walkthrough: 'device' signals ARER, a rearrangement of RARE.
explanation.definitionFit: A sheep is fleeced by the farmhand who clips its wool.

clue.text: The method computers use to vary output

definitions.text: The method computers use to vary output

parts.words: The method computers use to vary output
parts.note: a computer's setting of operation, which changes how it behaves

explanation.definitionFit: A way of working, and the setting of a machine such as a computer that selects its behaviour.

clue.text: Drill and what a soldier might describe it as

definitions.meaning: to make a hole by boring

definitions.text: what a soldier might describe it as
definitions.meaning: a soldier finds parade drill tedious

explanation.definitionFit: To drill is to make a hole, and a soldier finds parade drill tedious, a tiresome thing.

clue.text: Father needs it for making glass

parts.note: Fr is the abbreviation for a priest addressed as Father
taken as written

explanation.surface: A priest needs a certain thing for glassmaking.
explanation.definitionFit: Frit is the fused mixture of sand and fluxes used as a raw material in glassworks.

clue.text: One French veto to be included

parts.note: one is the Roman numeral I
non is French for no

explanation.surface: A lone French objector refuses to be part of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To be party to a secret or plan is to be included in it.

clue.text: Yet alcoholics exhibit a weakness for it

definitions.text: Yet alcoholics exhibit a weakness for it

parts.words: Yet alcoholics exhibit a weakness for it
parts.note: a paradox: the drinker's weakness is for something described as powerful

explanation.definitionFit: Spirits and other potent liquor are what problem drinkers crave, a powerful thing they are weak before.

clue.text: 50 points taken by newly weds

parts.note: read as the digits 5 and 0: V is the Roman five and 0 looks like the letter O
W and S are compass points, west and south

explanation.surface: A newly married couple scores fifty points.
explanation.walkthrough: '50' is split into its digits, 5 (Roman V) and 0 (letter O).
explanation.definitionFit: A married couple make solemn promises to each other at their wedding.

clue.text: Change can, in an old horse, be first this way then that

parts.note: to change is to alter

indicators.note: the word for can sits within the horse

parts.note: a nag is an old horse
a can is a tin

explanation.surface: Changing a can inside an old horse makes it swing one way then the other.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' puts TIN inside NAG to make NATING; 'an' and 'be' are links.
explanation.definitionFit: Something swinging back and forth by turns, like a current reversing direction.
